_comment: Hivework pipeline config (schema_version 2). One ordered `pipeline` block, each stage carrying BOTH its provider/model AND its own tuning knobs, named after the run stage it drives (decompose / fanout / judge / ...). This replaces the v1 grouped layout (scattered roles + stages + ops); the loader still reads v1 files, so old profiles keep working. A `model` of `@stage` reuses that stage's model. The hive.config.default profile is what `hive run` loads with no --profile.

coordinator._comment: Opt-in queen front-end interpreter (R0001), enabled by `hive run --coordinator`. Sonnet-tier by policy (low tier forbidden — it is the beginner's entry gate; cost is small at ~1 call/run). Was roles.coordinator.

decompose._comment: Splits the seed into leaf axes. Was roles.queen. Single call; retries covers the occasional rc=0 blank reply (T905).

fanout._comment: Source-mining swarm (was roles.swarm). enabled = old ops.swarm_run.allow; parallel = the previously-hidden max_workers; retries = the previously-hidden respecify retry; max_calls = new total ceiling. Actual calls = axes x (1 + retries). max_iterations / prune_keep_rounds (R0001 0077, HTTP provider only): per-drone agent-loop round ceiling and history-pruning window — the loop resends the whole transcript every round, so runaway drones grow quadratically; cap the rounds and keep only the last N rounds' tool outputs verbatim (older ones become head+stub). Omit both keys for the old behaviour (25 rounds, no pruning).

judge._comment: Post-decompose judgement (best-of-N). jury_size = old votes_per_axis; retries = old max_calls_per_axis - 1; max_calls = old max_total_calls; parallel = old max_parallel. (enabled is documentation only — judge has no off-switch in code.)

reinforce._comment: Was roles.scout + stages.reinforce. parallel = old max_workers; max_calls = old max_total_calls. Fires only on a coverage_risk axis whose FIND came back empty. Raise THIS model, not parallel, for better reinforcement.

split._comment: Per-locus elimination pass. model omitted = reuse this stage's model (roles.converge).

lens._comment: Adversarial refutation of a CONSISTENT converge attribution. One call per lens, reusing the fanout model (@fanout); a majority refutation demotes converged->False (routes to reinvestigation). Disable at runtime with HIVE_NO_LENS_REFUTE.

reinvestigate._comment: Meta-stage: no dedicated model (re-runs @judge / converge / specify). enabled = old reinvestigation.live; rounds = old max_rounds. Stops early when the re-grounded honey is unchanged.

assemble._comment: Stitches combs into the assembled finding. Single call.

specify._comment: Authors the edit-spec. Single (slow) author call; roomier timeout + one retry for the occasional transient.

review._comment: Effectiveness reviewer (specify's second pass). Single call.

commit._comment: Commit-plan author. Single call. Over filename_only_threshold changed paths, group by path/name only (do not open file contents).

copilot._comment: read_only=true runs every copilot worker with --deny-tool=write --deny-tool=shell (denial wins over --allow-all): it can read/grep the target but never edit it or shell out. All Hive copilot roles are read-only by design.

codex._comment: Codex CLI. lock_timeout_sec (seconds) = cross-process serialization mutex wait bound before a queued call gives up with TimeoutError.

openai._comment: OpenAI-compatible HTTP endpoint shared by the 'openai'/'deepinfra' provider names. Point base_url + api_key_env at any vendor; the key itself lives in the out-of-repo secrets file.

db._comment: Read-only DB connection for the converge data-state read (opened mode=ro).

tests._comment: Test runner for the runtime red->green verify; cwd is relative to the --codebase root.

http_shape._comment: Lever 7 HTTP-shape red-test harness. Set app_fixture to an EXISTING seeded TestClient fixture in server/tests, OR setup_block_file to a .py file (path relative to the codebase) holding imports + a @pytest.fixture that builds a seeded TestClient. Both empty = the lever stays a no-op.

apply._comment: apply --write backup window; cleaned up after backup_ttl_hours.
